caseName: Spring City Foundry Co. v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: Spring City Foundry Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Edgar L. Wood and Richard H. Tyrrell for petitioner. Solicitor General Biggs for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit is granted limited to the question whether a debt ascertained to be partially worthless in 1920 was deductible in that year under either § 234 (a) (4) or § 234 (a) (5) and to the question whether the debt was returnable as taxable income in that year to the extent that it was then ascertained to be worthless.
